title: Inventory Value report leaves out an untracked part
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-IVUNT-T1) is active and tracked at {Location-A}, with 4 in {Bin-A} at a cost of $10.00.
  • Inventory part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-IVUNT-U1) is active and untracked at {Location-A}, with 3 in {Bin-A} at a cost of $20.00.
  • Both part numbers start with the same prefix {Prefix-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-IVUNT-).
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Reports and open the Inventory Value report.
  2. Leave the as-of date on today.
  3. Set the Location filter to {Location-A} only.
  4. Type {Prefix-A} in the report's Search box.
  5. Read the rows listed.
  6. Read the Totals row.
  7. Go back to Parts → Inventory and search {Prefix-A}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: Exactly one row is listed: {Part-A} with Qty 4.00, Unit Cost $10.00 and Total Cost $40.00 (4 × $10.00 = $40.00). There is no row for {Part-B}.
  • Step 6: Totals reads Qty 4.00 and Total Cost $40.00. {Part-B}'s 3 × $20.00 = $60.00 is not added: the total is $40.00, not $100.00.
  • Step 7: The Inventory list is unchanged by the report: {Part-B} still shows "Not Tracked" with bin "{Bin-A} | 3", because the report change does not touch the stock.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10817 (Story 4, Create an Untracked Part); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S4-R9 and §2 Feature Overview, Accounting, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 5.3 (The list says Not Tracked) and tracking-note-2, 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Report labels (Qty, Unit Cost, Total Cost, Totals, as-of date, Location filter) are those of the Inventory Value report already in the build. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R9: “The Inventory Value report does not include untracked parts.”
  • PRD §2 Accounting: “The Inventory Value report leaves out untracked parts, because they keep no stock count to value. This is a report change only.”
